# Kestrel — project overview

Kestrel is the internal codename of the warehouse barcode-scanner mobile app.

- Owner: platform team.
- Launch target: pilot in one warehouse in December 2026.
- Approved budget: see line K-7 in the 2026 budget table (work/finance/budget-2026.csv). The amount is kept only there.

Out of scope for the pilot: offline sync and multi-warehouse reports.
